description: Grok Bot through the installer its update feed names, launched.
why: One install writes both values, so must_find alone would pass with either broken; require_rows names the running process and the Uninstall key each. Cursor is forbidden because Anysphere builds both, and its values are the other per-user install under ~\AppData\Local\Programs and the other Anysphere Uninstall key. Grok Build is forbidden because both carry the Grok name.
known_gaps: A match says the Grok Bot app is installed, not that a Bot ran or that a plan includes it.
The arm64 installer is not run: the runner is x64.
